techniques.name: AA-spell rotation
steps: rotate the best you can as spell will cancel the animations
if you run out of spell rotation, jump instantly after each AA instead
techniques.rhythm: "Between every AA you will send one spell, basically doing: AA - spell - AA - spell - AA - spell and rotating the best you can as spell will cancel the animations and you will have more DPS. If you run out of spell rotation, jumping instantly after each AA will also make you gain DPS."

gameplay.text: Both builds play similarly; Shortbow is "UNPLAYABLE" pre-Epic Schematic (base damage too low), and only becomes viable (still "insanely far away from good") once the Epic Schematic unlocks a poison-stack passive.
"Each Ability you Hit will MARK the enemy with poison stack, these poison stack will be exploded from AA. These Marks Deal HP% DMG."

"Both build rely on hitting spell, marking enemy and then making them explode with AA. With that you can Hit ANY target and will always [do] -40% to -60% of their HP. You will have a LOT of DMG but Kills are harder to get. As your DMG drop HEAVILY as the target get lower hp%."
